summary: diagnose: the live shiki loop self-drive (smoke task T-20260618T025401916227Z-fbc91ead) stopped at the pre-PR code-review gate with 'pre-PR code review did not pass (reviewer verdict could not be parsed; failing closed)'. Root cause: REVIEWER_ADAPTER omitted --output-format json. Without it, headless `claude -p --json-schema` returns natural-language prose (e.g. '**Verdict: clean** -- ...'), not the schema object, so parse_code_review_verdict found no JSON and (correctly) failed closed. Reproduced directly: prose on stdout, plus a spurious stderr 'Permission deny rule MultiEdit matches no known tool'.
